_meta.purpose: Shared ground truth for whether a calendar block shows its month name ('January 2026') above the grid, and what it says. The print decides with month_heading_enabled / month_heading_text in backend/django/services/calendar_renderer.py; the customer preview (MonthTileThumb) with monthHeadingEnabled / monthHeadingText in frontend/nextjs/src/lib/calendar.ts. On unless ops set calendar.showMonthName to false, or the layout uses the calendar.monthTitle overlay (which already prints a heading). 'calendar' is the layout's calendar block; null means the layout has none.
